title: I Just Invested $20,000 into the Stock Market (Here is what I bought)
creator: Mark Roussin CPA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions render SOXX as 'socks' and Waymo as 'Whimo'.
summary: On Thanksgiving Day, with markets closed, Mark Roussin shows exactly how he put about $20,000 to work over the past few days across four plays - two ETFs and two option trades. His framing is that the tech sell-off is nearing a bottom: valuations are way down even after adjusting 2027 earnings for slowdown fears, and he expects a relief rally possibly followed by one more leg lower, so he is accumulating high-quality assets rather than timing the exact bottom. First, the Invesco Nasdaq-100 ETF (QQQM, BUY): bought Friday last week and again Wednesday, a foundational position at a 0.15% expense ratio after the Nasdaq-100 briefly fell about 20% into a bear market. Second, the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX, BUY): bought Tuesday to own the basket - AMD, Nvidia, Micron, Broadcom, Intel, Texas Instruments and others - after one-month falls of 10-40% across the top holdings; he has trimmed individual semiconductor names but is not bearish on the industry. Third, Alphabet (GOOGL, BUY): his largest holding for years, now overtaken by Amazon; instead of buying more shares after a soft earnings report he bought a December 17 2027 $255 LEAP call for $58 per contract, $5,800 to control 100 shares versus $27,000 outright, planning to sell covered calls along the way, with break-even at $313. He likes Cloud, YouTube, Gemini, TPUs and Waymo even while search faces legitimate AI-disruption concerns. Fourth, Rocket Lab (RKLB, CONDITIONAL_BUY): he sold December 18 2026 $40 cash-secured puts for $310 per contract, keeping the premium if the stock stays above $40 or owning it at an effective $36.90 if assigned. He likes the space-systems business beyond launches and Neutron's larger market, with 8 Neutron missions worth over $500 million secured in Q3, though the inaugural launch slipped to the first half of 2027 and execution is the biggest risk.
